documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Goldiam International reported a strong start to FY27 with total revenue of INR 3,637 million and a doubling of profit after tax to INR 740 million. The company's export mix is now heavily dominated by lab-grown diamond jewelry, which accounts for 90.7% of total exports. Management is expanding its domestic retail brand, ORIGEM, with plans to add seven more stores by Diwali and a long-term target of 100 stores. The company maintains a robust order book of INR 2,250 million and expects continued growth momentum in the upcoming quarters. Goldiam International reported record performance in Q1 FY27, driven by strong B2B diamond studded jewellery exports and growth in domestic retail.

guidance.claim: The company expects a robust performance in the second and third quarters of the fiscal year compared to the previous record year.
guidance.quote: We are looking forward to a robust Q2, Q3 compared to already record FY26, and we hope to continue the growth.

guidance.claim: Management aims to achieve double-digit growth in non-American markets by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: So we'll be able to report to you that we'll have a double-digit growth in non-American areas as well.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a total of 100 stores for its ORIGEM brand over the next few years.
guidance.quote: we believe we will be in a great position to reach close to that 100 store figure that we are aiming and targeting to own with a much stronger sales per month per store metric that, again, we have targeted internally.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing strong traction and repeat orders in non-U.S. markets like the Middle East and Israel.
demand_outlook.quote: So close to outside U.S., the B2B businesses still remain small because we have started just last year, but the traction and order repeats are very strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Wholesale prices for lab-grown diamonds appear to have reached a stable base with some sizes seeing price increases.
demand_outlook.quote: In fact, in this quarter, we have even seen prices move upwards for certain sizes, especially the smaller sizes of lab-grown diamonds.

capex_expansion.claim: Goldiam plans to expand its geographic presence into Australia and Canada during the current fiscal year.
capex_expansion.quote: We are going to, in this fiscal year, further see and hopefully see provided meetings go well, deepening of presence in Australia, which has a similar consumption pattern to the U.S., Canada, which has again similar consumption pattern to the U.S.

capex_expansion.claim: ORIGEM operates 26 operational stores across 13 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: ORIGEM, Goldiam’s India retail lab grown diamond jewellery brand, now operates 26 operational stores across 13 cities in India.

margins_costs.claim: Steady state EBITDA margins increased to 24% after adjusting for tariff refunds.
margins_costs.quote: Steady state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration grew by 400 basis points to 24%.

margins_costs.claim: The company utilizes a dual casting method in the U.S. to improve its margin profile and supply chain solutions.
margins_costs.quote: This is, again, walking the talk as to what we have shared on our prior commitment and driven by the dual and hybrid casting method where we are casting in the U.S., delivering U.S. product of origin as a key supply chain solution for our customers

margins_costs.claim: Other income for the quarter included approximately INR 220 million from a tariff duty refund.
margins_costs.quote: Regarding Q1 itself, out of the other income described, INR22 crores approximately has come from tariff refund, tariff duty refund.

margins_costs.claim: Other income for Q1 FY2027 includes tariff refund received by the company.
margins_costs.quote: Other income for Q1 FY2027 include tariff refund received by the company.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in Customs Duty on gold to 15% shall not have a material impact on the operations, financial performance, or profitability of the Company.
margins_costs.quote: The recent increase in Customs Duty on gold to 15%, comprising 10% Basic Customs Duty (BCD) and 5% cess, we would like to inform you that the said increase shall not have any material impact on the operations, financial performance, or profitability of the Company.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book stood at approximately INR 2,250 million as of June 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on June 30, 2026 was about INR2,250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Lab-grown diamond jewelry exports represented 90.7% of the total export sales mix in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Lab-grown diamond jewelry exports contributed to 90.7% to the overall export sales mix during Q1 FY27 compared to 87.8% in Q1 FY26.

orders_capacity.claim: A significant portion of finished jewelry inventory is currently held with customers for subsequent sale.
orders_capacity.quote: About 64% of the inventory finished jewelry as on June 30, 2026 is with customers as finished jewelry stock of jewelry to be sold in subsequent months to their customers.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam's order book position as on June 30, 2026 was about 2250 million rupees.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam’s order book position as on June 30, 2026 was at about ₹ 2250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book as of June 30, 2026 is expected to be executed in the next three-four months.
orders_capacity.quote: This order book is expected to be executed in next three-four months.

orders_capacity.claim: E-commerce sales are not part of the order book as they are booked online on a spot basis.
orders_capacity.quote: E-commerce sales, given their nature of being booked online (on a spot basis), are not part of the order book.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued bonus equity shares in a 1:3 ratio during July 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: In July, the company allotted 3,76,39,281 equity shares of INR2 each as fully paid up bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1:3 by utilizing an amount of INR7,52,78,562.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents, including investments, totaled INR 4,566.7 million at the end of the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash and cash equivalents, including investments were at INR4,566.7 million as on 30th June.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ORIGEM retail brand recorded an operating loss between INR 50 million and INR 60 million for the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: There will be approx -- just to give a ballpark figure, it will be in the range between INR5 crores to INR6 crores of operating loss for the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Rising gold prices have made it difficult to convert customers for fine jewelry through online channels.
risks_headwinds.quote: What's happening as a result of the gold price increasing itself for -- globally speaking, is that in ORIGEM, the average ASP, the average sales price has gone up. And after a certain level, it's very hard to convert customers online.

risks_headwinds.claim: Through its US subsidiary, Goldiam began casting raw gold into unfinished jewellery pieces in the US in response to steep hikes in US tariffs.
risks_headwinds.quote: In September 2025, in response to the steep hike in US tariffs, through its U.S. subsidiary, Goldiam began casting raw gold into unfinished jewellery pieces within the United States itself, providing employment and job opportunities domestically in the US.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach a total of 100 stores for the ORIGEM brand.
management_commitments.quote: we believe we will be in a great position to reach close to that 100 store figure that we are aiming and targeting to own with a much stronger sales per month per store metric that, again, we have targeted internally.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to report double-digit growth in non-American regions by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So we'll be able to report to you that we'll have a double-digit growth in non-American areas as well.
management_commitments.timeframe: by the end of the year

management_commitments.quote: We are going to, in this fiscal year, further see and hopefully see provided meetings go well, deepening of presence in Australia, which has a similar consumption pattern to the U.S., Canada, which has again similar consumption pattern to the U.S.
